description: Single Ballerina service owning the product catalog, cart, checkout, and order lifecycle for the single-seller ceramics store. Exposes REST endpoints for browsing (public), cart/checkout (Shopper, signed in), and catalog/order management (Store Owner, signed in). Removes a piece from the catalog the moment it is purchased since every listing is one-of-a-kind. Does not send emails or process payments itself — it calls out to the email and payment providers. Does not serve any UI.
